theme_central: When the sky splits open, every soul will know what it has done and left undone — despite recording keepers who, day after day, had already recorded everything.

branches.title: Cosmic upheaval
branches.resume: Sky split open, stars scattered, seas made to burst forth, graves overturned.

children.t: Cosmic upheaval, every soul knows what it has done and left undone

branches.title: Man's ingratitude
branches.resume: What deceived you about your Generous Lord who created you in due proportion?

children.t: Man's ingratitude toward his Generous Creator

branches.title: Recording keepers, final requital
branches.resume: Noble scribes watching over each person; contrasting fate of the righteous and the wicked on the Day of Requital.
